<!-- pr-reviewer: 5f43e47e0edcc471d102ff0b7ecd39db178468f9 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (also covers the content of #482, reviewed here for the first time).

**What looks good**
- `posting::fixture_findings` -> `fixture_struck::op_hits` is a faithful extraction of the inline check on main: same tool lookup (missing tool is no hit), same `tool_body::judged` (a body that no longer fits is now `unjudged`, by name, never clear), same `steel_stack`/`MeshSteel`/`mesh_refined` (#476), same bands + posed rapids, same `workholding_for` (setup-mount filtering #471, carried fixtures #412 and the machine table via the same call), and the spindle is still read per op through `machine::of_setup(world, op.setup)` (#388). Nothing the main check did is dropped; the gate is not weaker.
- The viewport tint (`struck_by`, `fixture_highlight`) judges each fixture alone with the same `op_hits`, is view-only (no world writes; STRUCK_CLASS rides the vertex), and reports a warned move no single fixture reproduces as unresolved instead of guessing.
- `ImportFixture` is one undoable unit (landing + `FixtureDef`), validated at creation (refuses `Machine/Table` and an unknown setup by name; `UpdateModel` refuses setup furniture), `invert` restores the previous marker. A refused import no longer leaves `import_as_fixture` set for the next import.
- Layering ok (ui calls app commands/queues `CommandKind`s), no unwrap/expect/panic in non-test code, provenance lines present, no snapshot PNGs, no CHANGELOG edit, no build.rs/.github/scripts/deps changes. Body has `Changelog:` and `Refs #339`; decision file in `docs/decisions/`.
- The new test pins the per-setup spindle: Setup2 (20 mm housing) is active last, so reading `machine::of(world)` would acquit FaceBig and fail the `convicted.contains("FaceBig")` / `hits_of("FaceBig")` / `struck_by` asserts.

**Local results (merged with main, no conflicts)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| app `fixture_ux` | 9 passed |
| app `fixture_mesh` | 3 passed |
| app `fixtures` | 14 passed |
| app `posting` | 17 passed |
| app `setup_mounts_post` | 5 passed |
| app `carried_fixtures_cache` | 6 passed |
| ui `--lib -- fixture tree_menu` (CWD crates/ui) | 9 passed |
| clippy -D warnings app/ui/sim --all-targets | clean |

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs` is ~3.9k lines (already far over 400; this PR adds ~65). `fixture_view`/`state_fixture.rs` are the right direction; further growth is better split out.
- Not exercised: hands-on GUI check of the menu/tint (not run by the reviewer).
- This PR supersedes #482; the maintainer may want to close #482 with a pointer when merging (a `feat`, so merges at the cut).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
